answer: Because the orchard history dates every edge, the nebula audit rejects a connection created in the same window, so a farm cannot manufacture endorsements on demand. Attestation is only accepted from an identity holding a verified edge to the author, and edges need 11 epochs of prior interaction to count. That makes last-minute recruitment useless, because the voyage edge has to exist before the case does. A farm of 44 pays that 168 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
